head_coach.name: Hajime Moriyasu
head_coach.play_style_summary: Moriyasu's system emphasizes aggressive high pressing, rapid vertical transitions after turnovers, a compact mid-block, and fluid positional rotations between the lines with wide overloads.

key_players.name: Takefusa Kubo
key_players.performance_stats: Recorded 2 goals and 4 assists in 24 La Liga appearances for Real Sociedad in 2025/26. He registered 4 goals and 8 assists with 30 key passes during the 2026 World Cup qualifiers.

key_players.name: Ayase Ueda
key_players.performance_stats: Finished as a top striker in Eredivisie with 23 goals in 31 appearances for Feyenoord in 2025/26. Known for high physical work rate, winning 5.6 duels per game.

key_players.name: Ritsu Doan
key_players.performance_stats: Scored 5 goals and provided 6 assists in 31 Bundesliga matches for Eintracht Frankfurt in 2025/26. An elite 1v1 dribbler averaging 1.1 key passes per game.

injuries_and_absences.absence_reason: Withdrew from the World Cup squad on June 11, 2026, due to an aggravated foot ligament injury and subsequently announced his international retirement.
